# This pin governs both the license CI job (.github/workflows/licenses.yml)
# and the shipped API image (Dockerfile pip install -c).
# There is no Python lockfile. An unconstrained install resolves the newest
# certifi, and a new PyPI release would fail the pinned row in
# license-exceptions.toml without a repo change. Keep this pin equal to that
# row.
certifi==2026.10.19
